contracts.guarantee: Complete mediated dynamic read/effect closure and stable producer image
contracts.rely: Consumer uses the sealed image and admits all unknown capabilities
contracts.failureCustodian: Planner retains incomplete cut; scheduler cannot issue reuse

contracts.phaseScope: build request/output group and source generation
contracts.guarantee: All C/link metadata/diagnostic/effect observations reflect a successful complete producer group
contracts.rely: Planner validates full consumer projections, not only file length/hash at endpoints
contracts.failureCustodian: Publisher owns staged/partial results until accepted commit/discard

contracts.phaseScope: one host budget with child ownership distinct from GC counts
contracts.guarantee: Cancel request does not release a running job credit; physical completion returns it once
contracts.rely: Publisher terminal acknowledgement distinguishes exit request from settled child effects
contracts.failureCustodian: Scheduler retains credit for unknown child; publisher retains staged data

contracts.guarantee: Final registered slots are frozen, acquired, scanned and relocated values reloaded
contracts.rely: GC does not infer participation from RC record publication or callback entry
contracts.failureCustodian: Root custodian retains slots and old backing until accepted scan/reentry

contracts.guarantee: Every saved raw origin and precise frame root survives until traversal and lease drain
contracts.rely: Current stack scan does not imply captured closure; GC honors FrameSpec coordinates
contracts.failureCustodian: Control retains origin/backing on unknown traversal

contracts.guarantee: Nested callbacks preserve root protection and exception/continuation cleanup ownership
contracts.rely: Control restores VM binding and reloads moved slots before user code
contracts.failureCustodian: Entry custodian retains borrowed resources until exact exit acknowledgement

contracts.guarantee: Producer and descendant closure plus strong/weak/cleanup completion precede reclaim permission
contracts.rely: Resource consumer additionally closes target ingress and drains actual non-GC users
contracts.failureCustodian: GC owns unfinished tasks; release coordinator owns accepted destructor debt

contracts.guarantee: Release completion is an owner-scoped acknowledgement rather than a call to free/close
contracts.rely: Publisher cannot deliver success while handle cleanup or unknown I/O remains
contracts.failureCustodian: Release owner retains unacknowledged handles; publisher retains result debt
